title: WA UTC Docket 260540 — Order - Other: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
summary: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
text:
Commission Docket No.: 
Agenda Date Assigned: 
BEFORE THE WASHINGTON UTILITIES AND TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION 
LESS THAN STATUTORY NOTICE REQUESTED BY: 
Company Name: West Waste & Recycling, Inc. 
Certificate No. G-251 
UBI No. 601 498 268 
Registered Trade Name(s) West Waste & Recycling, Inc. 
Company proposes to change Tariff Number 3. 
The company requests Commission approval to amend its filed Tariff Number 3 on Less than Statutory Notice to include a 
Special Fuel Surcharge Tariff Supplement to recover the rising cost of fuel. Fuel index prices have increased from $3.89 per gallon 
for the base period to $5.83 per gallon current price. Proposed changes are to add a Special Fuel Surcharge Supplement No. 2026-
03 in the amount of 1.63%. 
(This section to be completed if filing is made by other than owner, partner, or corporate officer of the company) 
Name and title of issuing agent Heather Garland, Consultant is authorized to issue and file tariffs and/or time schedules on 
behalf of (name of company): West Waste & Recycling, Inc. 
Signature and title of authorizing agent (company official) Brent Gagnon, President 
Telephone number/fax/e-mail of authorizing agent: 360-374-5020. 
I request these provisions become effective: July 1, 2026, to expire: July 31, 2026 
Signature and Title of Issuing Agent: Heather Garland, Consultant 
Printed name of Issuing Agent: Heather Garland 
Telephone No. 360-903-6333 FAX No. E-mail: heather.garland@pacfinancial.net
Mailing Address: 930 Lighthouse Ct. City: Anchorage State: AK 
Zip 99515 
WASHINGTON UTILITIES AND TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION 
O R D E R 
1.
The Commission finds good cause to support the request and authorize the proposed changes to become effective
with Less Than Statutory Notice on: July 1, 2026.
2.
The proposed changes will expire on: July 31, 2026.
3.
The temporary 1.63% fuel surcharge in all rates and charges is the result of increased fuel costs incurred by the
company during the months of July 2026, to be collected from customers as follows:
For customers who are billed monthly for services in arrears, the fuel surcharge applies to all services provided in
the month of July 2026.
